headline: Chip Stocks Endure Longest Losing Streak Since 2006 as CoreWeave Credit Concerns Mount: This Week on Wall Street
summary: The iShares Semiconductor ETF is on a nine-session losing run unseen since May 2006, as the KOSPI posts its worst week since 2008, optical names suffer dot-com-era drops and Bank of America sees a Cisco echo.

headline: It's All About Interest Rates
summary: Inflation concerns, elevated oil prices and uncertainty over the Iran conflict are driving interest rates higher. Higher rates raise the bar for investing in broad data center expansion.
